title: Single hieratic sign, D. Assiut N13.1 TAS4 (AKU HT 28510)

object.name: D. Assiut N13.1 TAS4
object.content: Besuchertext (Scribe Iahmes. Temple of Djefaihapi. Hathor.); Lied (Song to "the face of this mistress")

source.attribution: Facsimile by Svenja A. Gülden, Ursula Verhoeven; AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 28510

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 28510; AKU grapheme U0410 (AKU GR 666). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: U36 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 483. Occurrence: line 2; find place Gebel Assiut al-gharbi; writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; ink colour "schwarz"; sign size 16 x 3.9 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Neues Reich, 18. Dynastie". Facsimile type: Digitalisat (AKU), by Svenja A. Gülden, Ursula Verhoeven. Rendered from the source SVG facsimile to PNG at 20 px/mm (long edge clamped to 160-600 px) on a white background with a white margin.
